findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Staff recently started using quat tablets to prepare sani-buckets because bleach was irritating hands. Quat test kit was not available for checking sanitizer solutions. PIC placed an order during inspection for quat strips and will send inspector a photo once test kit is available for use at the facility. 
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions in mg/L shall be provided.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed copies of reporting agreements were not available for kitchen staff at the time of inspection. Assistant director of food service noted paperwork for foodborne pathogens was signed at one point but was unable to locate documents. Employee health policy was discussed and documents were provided. Reporting agreements will be signed by all staff before the end of day. Ensure all staff that work in the kitchen have signed reporting agreements on file by next routine inspection. Volunteers are exempt from needing to have a reporting agreement on file but should still be educated on illness and when to refrain from coming in for shifts. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-203.11 Two metal stem food thermometers were observed reading at 80F and 90F at room temperature. Ice point method was used to check thermometers for accuracy, with one thermometer reading between 44F-46F and the other around 34F. Thermometers were calibrated to 32F during inspection. Ensure thermometers are frequently checked for accuracy and calibrated.
Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2F in the intended range of use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The food contact surface temperature of the dish machine ranged between 110F and 149F. Food contact surfaces must reach 160F when using water for sanitizing. Ensure the dish machine is fixed so food-contact surfaces are sanitized properly. Dishes will be sanitized in the 3 part sink until the dish machine is fixed. 

4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: All certified food protection managers must complete allergen training.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a drip at the single compartment prep sink when the faucet is off. This was brought to the attention of maintenance during the inspection. Repair plumbing to fix leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to be soiled in the dry storage room with what appear to be old mouse droppings and the glue traps in this area are soiled with dead bugs as well. School has monthly pest control. Make sure to keep old droppings cleaned up so that you can monitor for any new pest activity. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the outside bottom left corner of the microwave to be chipped, which creates unnecessary crevices that are not easily cleaned. Repair or replace microwave.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet wiping cloth sitting in the corner of the dish room where dirty trays are accepted. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution in between use.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to be soiled with rubber pieces from the mats and a dead adult roach under the tables in the dish area. Observed the glue traps in the dry storage to be soiled with dead crickets and roaches. Clean the floors in these area. Maintenance was notified 3 days ago that pest control in these areas needs attention.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed mouse droppings underneath the dry storage shelves. Manager states they caught a very small mouse on the glue trap last week. There are 3 glue traps present in the dry storage room and are monitored daily. Sentinel provides pest control. Clean the floor and continue pest control.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed one can of red beans stored with all canned goods to have a dent along the top seam. Can was removed from stock and set aside for credit. Check all canned goods when shipment arrives for dented cans and set aside while stocking shelves.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to have an accumulation of soil under the dish machine and connected tables. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Observed the door of the walk-in freezer to not be operable from inside the unit. Repair door so it can be opened from inside the unit. 750-1210 Walls and Ceilings, including doors, windows and similar enclosures shall be maintained in good repair.
